acceptance.given: The implementation worker has completed production implementation and the plan defines the maintainer as the repository integration authority.

oracle.expected: The frozen plan assigns review and acceptance of the worker’s output, and commit and merge authority, to the maintainer; its worker instructions do not authorize the worker to perform those actions on its own output.
forbidden: The worker is assigned to review or accept its own output.
The worker is authorized to commit or merge on behalf of the maintainer.
oracle.observable: Static inspection of the frozen plan’s ownership and authority clauses before implementation begins.

acceptance.then: The plan’s authority clauses preserve maintainer review, acceptance, and repository integration authority.
acceptance.when: Before formal RED, inspect the frozen plan’s worker and maintainer authority clauses and verify the assigned roles against the source constraint.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A plan-contract assertion over the frozen plan fails if the implementation worker is authorized to review or accept its own output, or to commit or merge for the maintainer.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Keep implementation-worker authority limited to production implementation; reserve review, acceptance, commit, and merge decisions for the maintainer.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No runtime or persisted-state change; restore the prior plan wording if the authority clause needs rollback.

slice_hint.state_transition: Implementation-only worker assignment transitions to maintainer-controlled review, acceptance, and repository integration after implementation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The frozen plan assigns output review and acceptance and commit/merge authority to the maintainer, and does not authorize worker self-review, self-acceptance, or maintainer-representative integration.

acceptance.given: The plan declares the test and plan inputs to freeze before formal RED, and declares the implementation worker’s production-owner allowlist.

oracle.expected: The plan requires tests, helpers, fixture bytes, selectors, plan, and Acceptance to be frozen before formal RED; limits implementation writes to declared production owners; and keeps every production owner out of immutable execution-snapshot inputs.
forbidden: A listed test or plan input is mutable after freeze during implementation.
The worker may change an undeclared production owner.
A production owner is also an immutable execution-snapshot input.
oracle.observable: Static contract checks against the frozen plan’s freeze sequence, declared write set, and execution-snapshot path list before RED and during implementation.

acceptance.then: The frozen plan establishes pre-RED input immutability, a bounded implementation write set, and disjoint production-owner and execution-snapshot paths.
acceptance.when: Before formal RED, inspect the frozen plan contract and compare its declared production owners, write boundary, and execution-snapshot paths.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A plan-contract assertion fails if any required input is not frozen before RED, the worker write set is not limited to declared owners, or an owner overlaps an immutable execution snapshot.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Specify pre-RED freezing, implementation write ownership, and separation between production owners and immutable execution snapshots.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No runtime or persisted-state change; revert the plan-contract edit if its ownership boundary is invalid.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unfrozen execution inputs and broad implementation authority transition to a frozen pre-RED contract and declared production-owner write boundary.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The plan freezes all named inputs before formal RED, constrains implementation writes to declared owners, and contains no production-owner path among immutable execution snapshots.

acceptance.given: A production dependency is shared by validation or regression cases and earlier proof is recorded against a candidate identity.

oracle.expected: The candidate/regression identity includes the shared production dependency, and a later change to that dependency invalidates affected earlier proof before it can be treated as current.
forbidden: A shared production dependency is omitted from candidate/regression identity.
Earlier affected proof remains current after a dependency change.
oracle.observable: Identity-component inspection and dependency-change replay/reconciliation checking for affected proof validity.

acceptance.then: Candidate identity and proof-currentness both reflect shared production dependency changes.
acceptance.when: During candidate identity construction and again when a shared production dependency changes, inspect the identity inputs and affected proof validity.

failure_intents.selector_intent: An identity and invalidation contract assertion fails if the shared dependency is absent from candidate identity or if affected prior proof remains current after its change.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind shared production dependencies into current candidate/regression identity and invalidate affected earlier proof when those dependencies change.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No runtime or persisted-state change; revert the plan contract wording if identity or invalidation semantics require correction.

slice_hint.state_transition: Candidate proof transitions from current to invalidated for affected cases when a shared production dependency changes.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The plan requires shared production dependencies in candidate/regression identity and requires affected earlier proof to be invalidated after a dependency change.

acceptance.given: Q2 is assigned authoring of the declared test support for a real production entry point.

oracle.expected: Q2’s write scope is limited to declared tests, helpers, and fixtures; the oracle invokes the real production entry rather than a mock product; and an unconstructable valid oracle causes contract repair without premature production changes.
forbidden: Q2 substitutes a mock product for the real production entry.
Production is written before its allowed stage to compensate for an invalid oracle.
oracle.observable: Static inspection of the Q2 write allowlist and test binding, plus fixture-root test-contract checks that identify the invoked entry and the invalid-oracle repair path.

acceptance.then: Q2 test support is confined to its declared test/helper/fixture paths and its oracle binds the real production entry; invalid oracle construction routes to contract repair.
acceptance.when: Before formal RED, inspect the Q2 authoring boundary and planned selector contract, then verify the oracle binding and invalid-oracle handling in the frozen test contract.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A test-authoring contract assertion fails if Q2’s declared writes include production, the oracle binds a mock instead of the real entry, or invalid oracle construction permits premature production changes.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Constrain Q2 to declared test support, bind its oracle to the real production entry, and require contract repair when a valid oracle cannot be constructed.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No runtime or persisted-state change; revert the Q2 plan-contract clause if its authoring boundary is invalid.

slice_hint.state_transition: Q2 test-support authoring transitions to a frozen valid real-entry oracle before RED; invalid oracle construction returns to contract repair.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The plan limits Q2 to declared test support, binds the oracle to a real production entry, and forbids premature production edits as a substitute for repairing an invalid oracle.
